thesis.heading: What is my thesis about?
thesis.answer: A few radio nodes have to track a moving target by radar and serve users with data at the same time, on as little power as possible. The target is a flat plate, so its echo depends on which way it faces. Every time slot, a PPO agent decides which nodes transmit, how much power each beam gets and where the sensing beam points, from the tracker’s estimate alone.
thesis.lesson_1: The plate costs about 3 W more than a sphere: the agent pays in power for not knowing exactly which way it faces.
thesis.lesson_2: A hidden seeding bug made “different” runs share training data. I rebuilt every comparison on matched trajectories.
thesis.requirements: Position accuracy within 0.5 m (Cramér-Rao bound) and user SINR of at least 10 dB, in every slot
thesis.setup: 4 nodes on a 120 m ring, 12-element arrays at 28 GHz, 2 static users, one moving plate target
thesis.physics: Plate RCS from geometrical optics, bistatic CRB, coordinated-turn EKF, multi-node MRT downlink
thesis.learning: PPO in Stable-Baselines3, compared against TRPO, A2C, SQN, BDQ and recurrent PPO
thesis.result: Both requirements met in 97.7 % of slots at 4.2 W average, of an 8 W budget, on 500 unseen trajectories. A random policy manages 2.6 %.
thesis.where: Project thesis at FAU, Prof. Robert Schober’s group (IDC)
thesis.status: Report in final draft, submission on 23 November 2026

ni.heading: What did I ship at NI Dresden?
ni.lead: Tools that help test engineers find why RF instruments fail production tests, now part of the team’s AI debug assistant.
ni.fig_speed: to retrieve failure data, down from over 10 minutes
ni.fig_rows: corrective actions returned for each new failure, from the closest past matches
ni.fig_types: anomalies isolated by a five-class sigma-band classifier
ni.how: I generalised a failure-signature matcher from one hard-coded test on a CSV extract to any test and parameter in the full measurement set, then rebuilt its query layer with batch processing and parallel workers. Both tools ship as agent skills with guardrails and end-to-end tests, used by test engineers at the Malaysia site.
ni.wrong: The first version was stable but far too slow to sit behind a conversation: every question went back to the production database.
ni.change: Put heavy processing behind a cache from day one. If an answer takes 30 seconds, people stop asking.
